faqs.question: How are BA placements at Swami Vivekanand Subharti University?
faqs.answer: Placements are good at Swami Vivekanand Subharti University for Bachelor of Arts courses. About 89 percent of students got placed in Swami Vivekanand Subharti University. The highest salary package offered by Swami Vivekanand Subharti University was INR 15 Lacs Per Annum for Bachelor of Arts course. Some of the top recruiters of Swami Vivekanand Subharti University in recent years include Infosys, Adobe, L&T, Amazon, Hyatt Regency, Wipro, Paytm, Honda, Aditya Birla Group, and HCL, among others.

faqs.question: When is the last date for admissions at Subharti University?
faqs.answer: Subharti University admissions are currently open. The university has not specified a deadline for admission to SVSU. Candidates can get admission to SVSU based on their merit in the last qualifying exam or entrance exam score. The university offers admissions on the basis of the scores obtained in national-level entrance exams such as NEET and CUET-UG for admission to specific courses. Subharti University Entrance Test (SNET) is also conducted by the university for admission to several UG and PG courses.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation and Airport Management - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Review of SVSU - Swami Vivekanand Subharti University.

review_content.Placements: The college provides 90 percent of placements. The highest package course offered is 5.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Air India, Indigo, etc. 75 percent of students get paid internships from college, and companies are IDFC, HDFC, etc. Top roles offered are Sales Management, Sales Operations, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides facilities like parking, sports, and Wi-Fi, but the infrastructure is not as good. Classroom tables are not comfortable, only from the outside. They also provide a good library to read and study. The hostel is very poor. They do not have enough space for 2 students to study and live. The food quality is also poor, but medical facilities are good; they have their own hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Totally satisfied with best faculty, good infrastructure, and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Top recruiters are Apollo Hospital, Lok Priya Hospital, and Subharti Hospital. Sports physiotherapist is the top role offered in our course. My batch is 2022 and it completes in 2026. Around 60 percent of students get placement. All students of my batch get internships in Subharti Hospital and Lok Priya Hospital.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms in my college are well-equipped with Wi-Fi and a library. The hostel infrastructure and environment are friendly. The food in the mess is good and hygienic, though not like home. Good medical facilities are available for students, along with some discounts on medical treatment.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Swami Vivekanand Subharti University.

review_content.Placements: Placement in our course was extremely decent, it was about 70%. The highest package offered in our course was 24 LPA. The average package was around 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Axis Bank, ICICI Prudential, Tata AIA Insurance, etc. Around 70% of students got internship offers.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi was available on the campus. Library and study center were very good. Quality of hostel was also good. Mess and canteen food were tasty. There was limited medical facility.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Subharti University is value for money.

review_content.Placements: Subharti University provides a broad range of graduate, post-graduate, and diploma courses. Here in Subharti the fee for all the courses is comparatively lower other private universities. There are 20 colleges on the 250 acres large campus.
review_content.Infrastructure: This college is best for medicine studies. Subharti University is recognised by UGC. I started my course BBA 2023, and this is the best for 1,10,000 fee. Subharti University provides broad range of graduate, post-graduate, and diploma courses. It has more than 250 acres of campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Practical and interactive learning. All the faculty are supportive of students. Good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: All the faculty are supportive of students. Good infrastructure. 55 to 60 percent students from my batch got placed. The highest package is close to 20 LPA while the average package remained between 3 to 3.5 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, Infosys, HCL, Axis Bank, Bajaj Motors, Paytm and Flipkart. About 40 to 50 percent students received internships in IT companies, manufacturing firms and finance organizations with some converting into pre placement offers. The major roles offered are software developer, system engineer, data analyst, HR associate and business development executive.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Well-qualified faculty members, lush green campus. Placement is a little dissatisfied.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is 20%. The highest package is 5 LPA, the average package is 3 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. Most companies are small startups from Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, and Gurugram that come for placements. Roles include support engineer, sales, customer support, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is really good. More than 300 computers in the engineering college. Free Wi-Fi is available in the library, but in the hostel, you have to pay. The library is big and has a good selection of books. Regarding the hostel, there are many hostels. VHR hostel campus offers good food, and all hostels have a good environment for studying. All facilities in the hostels are really good.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for MBBS at Subharti University?
overview_faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for Subharti University MBBS is INR 53.3 lakh. This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Aspirants need to pay the course fee after completion of the selection rounds to confirm their seat in the university. The total fee of MBBS includes caution deposit, one-time fee and tuition fee. Besides, aspirants also need to pay an application fee of INR 1,500 to register for a course.

overview_faqs.question: What is the application fee for SVSU?
overview_faqs.answer: The application fee for each SVSU course is INR 1,500. Aspirants can pay the application fee in any of the online payment modes. Candidates applying offline for admission can pay the application in the form of DD. Aspirants need to pay DD in favour of "Swami Vivekanand Subharti".

overview_faqs.question: Is MBBS available at Subharti University?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, Swami Vivekanand Subharti University offers 4.5 year MBBS course including one-year internship. Candidates who have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology with at least 50% aggregate (40% aggregate for SC/ ST) can apply for the SVSU MBBS course. Admission to MBBS course is based on NEET score.

paragraphs: Subharti University admissions begin with registration for a course. Candidates are then further selected based on their merit or entrance exam scores. Check below steps to get admission to SVSU:
STEP 1: SVSU Application Process 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online or download the application form and submit it in campus. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,500 to apply for a course. Aspirants applying online can pay fee via any of the online payment modes. For offline submission, aspirants must send a demand draft for fee payment.
STEP 2: Selection

Once the registration process is over, the university shortlists candidates based onSNET examor merit in the last qualifying exam. For MBBS, SVSU acceptsNEETscore for admission. Besides, SVSU also selects candidates for some of the UG courses based onCUET-UGor CUET-PG for PG programmes. The university might also conduct personal interview round for some of the programmes.

Afte the selection process is complete, shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Once the documents are verified, candidates are allotted seat in the university. Selected aspirants are then required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SVSU - Swami Vivekanand Subharti University.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like parking, sports, and Wi-Fi, but the infrastructure is not as good. Classroom tables are not comfortable, only from the outside. They also provide a good library to read and study. The hostel is very poor. They do not have enough space for 2 students to study and live. The food quality is also poor, but medical facilities are good; they have their own hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with best faculty, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms in my college are well-equipped with Wi-Fi and a library. The hostel infrastructure and environment are friendly. The food in the mess is good and hygienic, though not like home. Good medical facilities are available for students, along with some discounts on medical treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Swami Vivekanand Subharti University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi was available on the campus. Library and study center were very good. Quality of hostel was also good. Mess and canteen food were tasty. There was limited medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Subharti University is value for money.

Subharti University provides broad range of graduate, post-graduate, and diploma courses. It has more than 250 acres of campus.

reviews.review_heading: Practical and interactive learning. All the faculty are supportive of students. Good infrastructure.

The canteen is good for snacks and meals, and the highlight is the on-campus hospital that ensures 24/7 medical support. Sports facilities are also impressive, with playgrounds, courts, indoor games, and a gym, making campus life

admission_process.title: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research S.A.S. Nagar Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, SAS Nagar admissionsare mainly entrance-based. Also known as NIPER SAS Nagar or NIPER Mohali, it is a public pharmaceutical research institute established in 2007. In 2019, the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranked NIPER SAS Nagar 3rdin pharmaceutical studies. The institute offers admission to programmes at the PG and doctoral levels.  offers programmes such as MPharm, MS (Pharm), MBA (Pharm) and MTech (Pharm) at PG level. Applications for all the programmes are invited in online mode only. At the doctoral level, the University offers a PhD in different disciplines of Pharmacy. NIPER SAS Nagar admission is entrance-based. Read the following article to learn all about the courses, admission criteria, and process for the institute.

NIPER SAS course admissionis subject to the fulfilment of the preset admission criteria. The institute accepts candidates primarily on an entrance basis. Some key highlights for the college are as follows:
Check out the following table to learn about the eligibility & selection criteria forNIPER SAS courses:

To get admission into the NIPER SAS Nagar, students must fulfil the admission criteria and go through a multi-step admission process. This includes appearing for the institute-level test, followed by PI and other selection rounds. Selected students can then proceed accordingly. The application process is carried out online. Interested students can follow the step-by-stepNIPER SAS Nagar admission processmentioned below:
Step 1: Application

Visit the official website of the institute to apply for the desired programme by registering yourself online and filling out the application form duly. Submit the required documents and application fees to complete the process.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Students are selected based on their academic merit and entrance exam performance. Final selection is made on the basis of academic performance + entrance test scores + Personal Interview conducted by the college.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Once a seat is offered, students need to pay the admission fees to secure their spots at the college.

reviews.review_text: Excellent buildings, well maintained hostel rooms, digital classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, especially the library in which they are having large number of books related to various subjects, Library is equipped with air conditioning and the books available to lent for free for few days.

reviews.review_heading: Good Placement and really very nice infrastructure.

In all labs AC are provided and lab for MS having well sophisticated instruments. In NIPER 5 hostel provided,  2 only boys, one for only girls, one for boys and girls and one married hostel is there. Hostels are well maintain and also mess facility provide in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to flourish because of resources and faculty. But, huge scope to improve on placements.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure is one of the institutes asset. Infrastructure includes AC classrooms, huge labs with sufficient laboratory equipments and reagents, hostels, computer centre, library, Wi-Fi, ambulance, gym, playground, cafeteria, swimming pool and many other. I did not faced issue with infrastructure. Food available from hostel is palatable and of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: I don't like the seniors behavior with the juniors they treat them like a servant.

overview_faqs.question: Is there BTech available in Assam University?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, Assam University offers BTech courses through its own college named Trigun Sen School of Technology. faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Assam University?
faqs.answer: Assam University offers over 86 UG, PG, diploma, doctoral, and certificate programmes in various fields, such as Engineering, Arts, Science, and Commerce, and for admission in many of the courses and specialisation there are specific entrance exams such as CUET-UG for admission in UG courses, CUET-PG for admission in PG course, JEE-Main for admission in BTech course.Students need to prepare well for the aforesaid entrance examinations because having a good rank will ensure that the candidate becomes eligible for further counselling, followed by document verification and fee payment.

faqs.question: Does Assam University accept admission through CUET-UG?
faqs.answer: Assam University accepts admission through various national-level, state-level & university-level entrance exams. faqs.answer: Assam University accepts admission in MCom through CUET-PG, for which the candidate should have passed BCom with a minimum of 50% aggregate. Therefore, candidates willing to take admission in MCom at Assam University must take the CUET-PG exam and must prepare well to achieve a good rank because only those applicants whose rank is above the closing rank specified in the merit list released by Assam University will be considered for the counselling round followed by the document verification and fees payment.Also, 50% of the MCom course seats are reserved for Assam University internal students, i.e., those who have passed the qualifying examination from Assam University affiliated college.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

The institute accepts various national-level or state-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, LUMAT, UPTU and more. reviews.review_heading: Average college experience with poor placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite average. Classrooms are not very well maintained, and labs lack updated equipment and proper software. Wi-Fi is available but not very reliable. The library has limited books, and seating space becomes an issue during exams. Hostel facilities are just manageable, with food quality in the mess being average and repetitive. Sports facilities are minimal. There are hardly any proper grounds for outdoor activities. Medical facilities on campus are also not very effective.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty & industry focus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good, and the infrastructure is also very good. Wi-Fi is available for students. Classrooms are very smart, and projectors are available. The library has lots of books, and every book is available for issue to the students. Hostel facility is good, and canteen snacks and meals are tasty and delicious.

reviews.review_heading: The facilities are not really good, but the placements are good.
reviews.review_text: It is good, including faculty, hostel, and canteen. All types of food are available in the canteen. Wi-Fi is not available for students. Sports are available, but only for first-year students, not for second and third-year students. Hostel food is very bad, and the taste is poor.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and good placement.
reviews.review_text:
Labs are good, the class is good, and the library is clean.
Yes, there is good faculty, good and healthy food, and medicine available all the time. Sports, games, and hostel life are enjoyable. Studying with hostel games, healthy food, and medicine is available all day.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Will never recommend anyone to take admission there.

reviews.review_heading: Only educational institute.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in Lucknow.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and teaching quality.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities, but dissatisfied with the placement and feel.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good teachers.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent facilities and infrastructure. Almost all facilities are available. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The library is open 24X7.

content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is decent for a government medical college. Lecture halls are good, with LH 4 being the biggest, used for first-year students. Labs are functional. The hospital has a good patient load, which helps us learn a lot and improves clinical learning. Hostel facilities are not very good but are manageable. We do not have an indoor badminton court, but there is outdoor space and a volleyball court.

content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with digital boards but the Wi-Fi facility is not so good. Drinking water facility is also available at the department for the students. individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Psychology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: 3 fruitful years at M. O. P.

content.Placements: There are so many internship opportunities provided to the students. Career skills training is also given. The placements for psychology start at the end of the 5th semester. But most of the offerings are related to HR. Only a handful of people apply for placements, while 99% of the students continue with post-graduation. Comparatively, there are not many placement opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: There is a special psychology lab, food science lab, and creative visualization labs too. Students can use the Wi-Fi. Each class is quite ventilated and provided with a smart board. Students can access the library and cafeteria. There is no hostel and bus facility. Students have to either use public or private transport. There are a lot of PG hostels available nearby. MOP excels at sports. However, the facilities inside the college are not that good, so it tries to partner with various private services. There are also vending machines, and the cafeteria is run by Nithya Amritham and Hot Breads. Food is quite expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty, infrastructure, opportunities, campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, pathetic, plus environmentally friendly. One never gets bored in college. Every student has their own Wi-Fi passwords, which are given by the college, and students can use them whenever they need to. Canteens are hygienic and serve healthy, yummy and a variety of dishes at convenient prices.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels were good. All of us were provided with single rooms from second year onward with 24 hours electricity, water and internet. LAN ports were available in every room. Mess food was average. It provided 4 meals a day. Hostel fee was Rs 15,000 per year for a single room. Mess fee was Rs 24,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: MOP- A great place for UG.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very compact yet very professional, well-maintained, and sophisticated. The college provides good infrastructure that facilitates students to engage more with academics. The library has a large quantity of books from diverse fields that helps students in research. The classrooms are perfect for learning with AV projectors and leg space.

reviews.review_heading: M. O. P vaishnav college for women.
reviews.review_text: The MCA and MBA departments share common laboratories for projects and research with over 200 systems available. During fests and events the college is well decorated by the management and students are given some responsibilities to promote their growth.

reviews.review_heading: 3 fruitful years at M. O. P.
reviews.review_text: There is a special psychology lab, food science lab, and creative visualization labs too. Students can use the Wi-Fi. Each class is quite ventilated and provided with a smart board. Students can access the library and cafeteria. There is no hostel and bus facility. Students have to either use public or private transport. There are a lot of PG hostels available nearby. MOP excels at sports. However, the facilities inside the college are not that good, so it tries to partner with various private s...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the experience is average in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: Students have access to air-conditioned libraries. There are well-equipped labs and decent classroom facilities with projectors. We lack a proper sports field due to the small size of the campus. Canteen serves hot bread and Nithya Amirtham, mostly outsourced so the quality is decent. We also have access to vending machines.

reviews.review_heading: Life in MOP Vaishnav College for Women.
reviews.review_text: Students are offered labs with Wi-Fi, a library, a canteen, an auditorium, parking spaces, seminar halls, and classrooms with projectors. A medical facility is also offered at the campus that is offered by Apollo Shine. The canteen is a base for Nithya Amirtham and hot breads.

reviews.review_heading: Good Placements in 2022, Average infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, we do have all facilities, only thing is the college is very small, not very spacious, otherwise we have all facilities required for the course, a library with many books, Wi-Fi, and we have newspapers as well. Canteen is good but not that cheap.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. Students have separate Wi-Fi access with an individual private password. Labs and classrooms are good. The library is available in our college. The hostel facility is not available in our college. Our college has a canteen. They serve vegetarian food items. They provide medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are spacious and beautiful. The best thing is that the hostels are within the college, so you don't have to worry about going to classes. The food served in the mess is very good. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Review of M.O.P. Vaishnav College for Women.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not provide hostel facility. It has Wi-Fi facility but in most cases, it does not work for students. Apart from these, it has good projectors in classrooms, well-equipped computer labs, and food labs. Library has several books that we need for academic purposes and we can borrow books for free for a maximum of 2 weeks. I would rate 3 out of 5 for food quality and taste for the food provided in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college.
reviews.review_text: There is a nice library with all the new collection of books. Quality of food is good. They have Apollo shine inside the campus. There are many guest lectures conducted which are useful. The canteen is neat. They have many stalls inside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members here will support you always.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility. It's a compact campus, yet very effective. There are many hostels in and around the college. The canteen food is average and sometimes good, yet there is a possibility of changing the contract if students are unsatisfied. The price is reasonable.

reviews.review_heading: M.O.P. Vaishnav College for Women has good campus life.
reviews.review_text: The food available in the college canteen is well and good but a bit expensive. It used to be even good. There's a slight change due to the change of contract of the caterers. This doesn't make pretty much a difference. There are a variety of food and snacks available all the time. The college doesn't have a hostel for students to reside and study. You will have to look for some PGs to stay. There are several safe and hygienic women's hostels in and around Nungambakkam for your convenience.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very nice college to enjoy your college life.
reviews.review_text: There is an amazing infrastructure with properly equipped furniture. Screens were also available in all the classrooms to connect our laptops and make presentations. There is an amazing canteen, and hygienic and pure vegetarian food is served. The library had a nice collection of books from all categories. Labs are very nice as well. The medical room is available in case of emergency. Sports should be given much emphasis here.

admission_overview.college_name: JSPM University Admission: Eligibility, Fee, Application & Selection Criteria

paragraphs: JSPM University, Pune admissionis either merit-based or entrance-based. The University offers more than twenty courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral levels, via its different constituent schools under various faculties. Candidates, seeking admission atJSPM University, are required to meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and then fill out theJSPM application formthrough the official website before the stipulated deadline.
JSPM University Admission 2024: Eligibility & Selection

Admission to most of theJSPM coursesis entrance-based. However, for some particular courses such as BSc, BCA, BBA, BCom, etc., the University shortlists candidates based on their performance in the qualifying exam. Candidates, however, for all courses are required to meet minimum eligibility criteria to get shortlisted for any and every course offered by JSPM Univeristy. Check below popular JSPM University courses along with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Eligibility
Graduate in any stream with a minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved category
MBA-CET/CAT/MAT/ATMA/GMAT/XAT/CMAT/ Preeminent Education & Research Association (PERA).
Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Maths as compulsory subjects with 45% marks (40% mark for reserved category)
CET/JEE/ Preeminent Education & Research Association (PERA).
Class 12 or Diploma in any discipline with a minimum 45% marks (40% mark for reserved category)
Merit-based
Class 12 or Diploma in any discipline with a minimum 45% marks (40% marks for reserved category)
Merit-based
BSc in relevant specialisation with a minimum 45% marks (40% marks for reserved category)
BE/ BTech in relevant discipline with a minimum 50% marks (45% marks for reserved category)
BSc in Physics, Mathematics or B.C.A. or any B.Tech. degree with 45% marks (40% marks for reserved category)
MCA CET/NIMCET/ PERA
Make your course selection here, to check the complete admission process.
JSPM University Admission Process 2024

JSPM University, Punehas a multi-step admission process which students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the shortlisting process is completed, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university, post which interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Candidates must check the eligibility criteriahere, before filling out the admission form.Step 1: JSPM Application Process 2024Students interested in getting into JSPM University must submit the online application form for all UG and PG courses at,https://jspmuni.ac.in/admission.phpas per their preferred course. The JSPM application process is completely conducted in online mode.

Step 2: JSPM Selection Criteria 2024 & Release of Merit ListThe JSPM admission criteria for some courses is merit-based and for some, it is entrance-based. After the applications are submitted, the University shortlists candidates based on the selection criteria of the course. reviews.review_heading: Life at JSPM: Faculty members are good, but I think it has more fees.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good. There is a separate lab building where there is a Mac lab, a gaming lab, a graphic design lab, and 1 big library. All over the campus, there is Wi-Fi connectivity. No hostel facility is provided by the college. Outside the campus, there are many hostels, PG, and mess facilities. There is 1 big food court in the college and 2 cafeterias inside the campus. A great quality of several foods is available.

reviews.review_heading: The environment is chaotic and not safe.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi. The classrooms and library are average. Sometimes students are not allowed to go into the library. There is no hostel for boys. The third-party hostels have horrible food and no medical facilities in the college. So nothing better can be expected from those hostels. Games are held only once a year during the sports meet in a week. Otherwise, there are no games.

reviews.review_heading: I am experiencing no college life here.
reviews.review_text: They provide Wi-Fi everywhere on campus, but drinking water is not provided in sufficient quantities and there are very few water filter machines placed. Classrooms are decent, but labs are excellent, and they consist of high-specification computers. Labs are huge in size, and there is a separate building for them. The infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is good at teaching. It has a good campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is nice. There are labs for students for their better studies but there is no Wi-Fi on campus. There are jammers for it and the network is not working properly. Classrooms are nice but fans and some lights are not working properly. It is a famous college in Pune but there is an issue with water in toilets.

reviews.review_heading: Good at teaching and theory but do the wrong thing for fees, don't allow some people for exam too.
reviews.review_text: Our college is very decent. Our department doesn't have much of PCs, all of them are outdated and not easily accessible. It provides decent Wi-Fi and classes do not use more technology especially in our class even lights are not working. No AC within the classroom and no e-learning a basic board and chalk.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied a little but college charges a lot.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is currently working. Labs are fine and with a good and big classroom, the environment is pretty much decent for studies, and with qualified faculty members its now becoming a good to better college with support for students career growth. Hostels are only available for girls so get details about PGs nearby. Library are decent and have beautiful and big reading halls that's a plus point. Labs are also decent with good specifications for better performance.

reviews.review_heading: The course and hostel infrastructure is average with basic facilities and room for improvement.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course and department are good and also have good Wi-Fi. Labs and classrooms are there. Libraries are there but sometimes not that many books are available in the library. The infrastructure of the college is average. There are no advance labs, but the overall environment is satisfactory for studying. Sports activities are limited.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure of the college is very attractive, we have a huge ground and a gym.
reviews.review_text: The labs and classes are just awesome, with all the necessary equipment. We have Wi-Fi access in every classroom. We also have a big library and a separate reading hall. We have a huge playground where matches are held, a gym for exercise, and a garden to chill.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have fans or ACs, and each building has labs. There is also a separate library building for reading in my college. The campus is very big, and  buildings are good, but there are some cleaning issues. Not the topic buildings are very clean.

reviews.review_heading: It has a big campus and a canteen.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and the food they provide are also good. It has strict rules for the students who are in the hostel for their entry and exists. There is more strictness on girls, and it is really difficult for them to get the gate pass. The washroom facilities and overall area are too good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and infrastructure are quite good.
reviews.review_text: Facilites are good with high-tech and digital classrooms. It has CCTV and also good speed Wi-Fi for students as well as faculty members. The campus is clean, with good faculty members doing the same. The canteen present inside the campus is good and clean with low prices.

reviews.review_heading: JSPM University is a good university. If you want, you can continue here for your good future life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice but mostly I don't like it personally, but there is a food court which is the best part of our university. There is a digital marketing board for each classroom. Overall, everything is good. There is a big library for students and a big digital library is also available which helps us to study good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is the best.
reviews.review_text: In our department, many facilities are provided by the faculty members like Wi-Fi, labs, digital TVs, water filters on each floor, a library, washrooms, staff rooms for faculty members, etc. Our department also provides a gym, sports ground, yoga hall and workshops. There are 2 food courts and 2 cafeterias for students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, and it focuses on building an entrepreneur rather than working under a company.
reviews.review_text: There are a total of 6 buildings, each one belonging to different faculties like the Faculty of Technology, Faculty of Law, etc. The labs have very good PCs, and there is also a Mac lab. The library is 3 floors, and there is Wi-Fi. The PCs in the library are new, and there are labs also in the library.

reviews.review_heading: The campus and faculty are very good for study. It has very good placements in the year 2024.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms and labs are too good and well-developed. They have smart TVs for better understanding with silence. There are two main buildings of the university, and others are from different colleges like ICOER, BSP, and the University. The university has its own specialized library for better study with a silent and peaceful atmosphere. Wi-Fi is accessible to everyone in the college, but there is no range in the college for calling purposes.

review_summary.college_name: SGSITS Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The facilities and placements are decent, but the fees are a bit high.

content.Placements: Currently, I am in the 1st year of the SGSITS Indore Electrical Engineering branch. Approximately 60% of the total students were placed in core and technical sectors. The highest package was 19 LPA offered by ORACLE Inc. in a technical role. The average was 7.5 LPA. The lowest package was 3.5 LPA offered by TCS. The top recruiters include Havells, Oracle, Deloitte, and TCS. The top roles were in core and technical sectors.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities provided by the college are decent, but the fees being charged for them are a bit too high. The classrooms and labs are equipped with all the required instruments. The library is good, and a lot of books are available here that are needed for every course. The food is decent, but again, the fees are very high. The total fees for a semester are 48,000 rupees. The sports facilities are not that good, but you can play almost all the casual games. The gymkhana is good and is equipped with all the workout equipment, and the charges are 400 rupees per month.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Teachers are supportive, and have a good placement record compared to others in Madhya Pradesh.

content.Placements: Around 80% students' placement data of CSE, IT, ECE and around 50-60% for other branches. The highest package goes around 25 LPA, and the lowest around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Mastercard, Goldman Sachs, Oracle, etc. Almost all students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: You will get all basic facilities, including a library, all sports facilities, well-equipped classrooms and Wi-Fi facility with a computer lab. Medical facilities are also available, and hostel and mess food are average. If you do not want the college hostel, there are many PG flats available in nearby areas.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good, but students are not satisfied due to the increase in fees.

content.Placements: 80 to 85 percent students get placed other go for higher studies and some go for government exam preparation. The highest package is approximately 25 LPA, the lowest is 5 LPA and the average package is 7 LPA. Top companies are Larsen and Turbo, L&T, Tata Projects, kalpataru etc.
content.Infrastructure: College has good facilities, it has a large cricket ground. Good basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, lawn tennis court. The college has a vast collection of books in the library. Students get a monthly magazine and daily English and Hindi newspapers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is better for the students in Madhya Pradesh than other private or government colleges.

content.Placements: Good for a state engineering college. Placement rates vary by branch and batch but are typically strong for CSE/IT and improving for core branches. IT services and product companies TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, some product firms and startups, regional manufacturing and engineering firms. In recent years, Tier-1 Indian product startups and mid-sized firms have participated. The average package is around 12 to 13 LPA for CS and IT, and the highest is 24 LPA by Goldman Sachs on campus.
content.Infrastructure: The campus of the institute has amenities like a Co operative store, Dispensary, Bank, Canteen, Staff Quarters, Hostels, Gymnasium, Sports Complex, etc. Very soon, there will be a post office inside the campus. The Golden Jubilee Auditorium of the institute has a seating capacity of 275 people. The canteen of the college serves food and beverages to students, staff and faculty members.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members here are very interactive and supportive.

content.Placements: For specifically CS, IT, and ECE, the placements here are pretty good, and for core branches like ME, CE, EE, and EI, they are not up to the mark, it was around an average of 5 LPA to 6 LPA. There are other branches like IPE and BME, particularly BME and IPE, where the average salary offered is 3 LPA to 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: SGSITS hostels offer decent, sometimes basic, accommodations. However, hostels here are expensive but have good amenities. Food quality is mixed (average to poor in general, better in newer messes), medical care involves a dispensary, and sports facilities include grounds and indoor games, though reviews suggest food/facilities vary, with many nearby cafes offering better food options than the canteen.

admission_overview.college_name: SGSITS Admission 2025: Courses, Eligibility, Process, Fee, Dates

paragraphs: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology & Science (SGSITS) is Rajiv Gandhi Prodyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV) constituent institute. SGSITS offersUG and PGlevel across the streams of Engineering, Technology and Medicine & Health Science. SGSITS admission is entrance-based for flagship courses, such asBTech and MBA. Admission to the BTech programme at SGSITS is based on the scores secured in theJEE Mainexam. Whereas, admission to the MBA programmes needs the candidates to haveCMATscores. SGSITS also provides BTech and MTech programmes for working professionals.

SGSITS offers nine specialisations in the BE programme. Admission to this programme is based on JEE Main score followed by two state-level counselling rounds conducted by DTE. For seat allotment, the institute also further conducts a counselling round. SGSITS provides online programmes and programmes in Engineering for working professionals. Candidates wanting to pursue a course from the university can fill out the respective course application form. For SGSITS admissions to various UG & PG courses, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria, followed by the other selection rounds. Find below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related toSGSITS courses:

SGSITS feesmay include various components such as Tuition Fees, Admission Fees, etc. Candidates have to pay a certain amount of fees at the time of admission. The university accepts various payment methods, including, credit card, debit card, net banking, and UPI. The table below mentions theSGSITS Feesand average package for various UG & PG courses:
Note: This information is taken from official sources/ sanctioning bodies and is subjective.

SGSITS seat intakevaries as per the course and specialisation selected by the students. To secure a seat at the university students must participate in the counselling. SGSITSseatsvary for both on-campus and affiliated colleges. Students can check out the following table to learn about the total seat intake for some of the popular SGSITS Dharwad courses:
Note: This information is taken from official sources/ sanctioning bodies and is subjective.
SGSITS admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process around SGSITS admissions 2025:
Step 1: SGSITS Application Process 2025

SGSITS admission process 2025 starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at SGSITS. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG and UG courses at SGSITS is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as JEE Main and CMAT for the selection of respective courses.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: The facilities and placements are decent, but the fees are a bit high.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college are decent, but the fees being charged for them are a bit too high. The classrooms and labs are equipped with all the required instruments. The library is good, and a lot of books are available here that are needed for every course. The food is decent, but again, the fees are very high. The total fees for a semester are 48,000 rupees. The sports facilities are not that good, but you can play almost all the casual games. The gymkhana is good and is equipped ...

reviews.review_heading: Teachers are supportive, and have a good placement record compared to others in Madhya Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: You will get all basic facilities, including a library, all sports facilities, well-equipped classrooms and Wi-Fi facility with a computer lab. Medical facilities are also available, and hostel and mess food are average. If you do not want the college hostel, there are many PG flats available in nearby areas.

reviews.review_heading: College is good, but students are not satisfied due to the increase in fees.
reviews.review_text: College has good facilities, it has a large cricket ground. Good basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, lawn tennis court. The college has a vast collection of books in the library. Students get a monthly magazine and daily English and Hindi newspapers.

reviews.review_heading: College is better for the students in Madhya Pradesh than other private or government colleges.
reviews.review_text: The campus of the institute has amenities like a Co operative store, Dispensary, Bank, Canteen, Staff Quarters, Hostels, Gymnasium, Sports Complex, etc. Very soon, there will be a post office inside the campus. The Golden Jubilee Auditorium of the institute has a seating capacity of 275 people. The canteen of the college serves food and beverages to students, staff and faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members here are very interactive and supportive.
reviews.review_text: SGSITS hostels offer decent, sometimes basic, accommodations. However, hostels here are expensive but have good amenities. Food quality is mixed (average to poor in general, better in newer messes), medical care involves a dispensary, and sports facilities include grounds and indoor games, though reviews suggest food/facilities vary, with many nearby cafes offering better food options than the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: B. Pharma review at SGSITS Indore.
reviews.review_text: Labs are updated, and frequent industry visits take place, though limited in the first year. The library is the same for B. Tech and B. Pharma for all years' students. Hostel is run down, and food is horrible. Wi-Fi isn't available in hostels. There are lots of water problems in the hostel. Very limited medical facilities exist. There is a first aid shed outside the first-year boys’ hostel, which is only open for the first few hours of the day and remains closed the rest of the time.

reviews.review_heading: If you are from Madhya Pradesh, then definitely prioritize this college.
reviews.review_text: The campus size is small, but the college is located in the centre of the city, Indore, so everything is nearby. Don't expect quality faculty, the labs are a little too old, campus has only 1 cafe, canteen food is good, but hostel food is like 3/10. The hostel seats are very limited for boys.

reviews.review_heading: It has high fees with zero facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are very bad because the hostels are very old. The hostel food at my college is very bad. Sports facilities are not much better. There is no Wi-Fi in hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: It has strong academics with growing placements.
reviews.review_text: The Civil Engineering department at SGSIT Sindhor is well-equipped with special classrooms, Wi-Fi, modern labs, and a rich library that supports both academic and projects. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, regular maintenance, and basic medical support. The mess and canteen provide average food. Sports grounds and indoor games encourage recreation and fitness. Overall, the infrastructure balances academic and study life efficiency.

reviews.review_heading: It is overall a good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms and labs are good. I don't know about hostel facilities as my sister lives in a rented flat, but she said that the college is good, the campus is also good, and the labs are pretty good, so that you can learn something, whatever your course is.

reviews.review_heading: SGSITS has good faculty, average placements, large alumni network, very high fees and limited campus
reviews.review_text: The campus size of our college is just 35 acres. Considering the limitations of the area, the campus is built well. It has a cricket ground, a basketball court, a tennis court, and a sports complex. It has a computer lab, a central library, stationery, a gymnasium, a canteen, and a dining hall. Wi-Fi is not available in the whole campus its available in a few parts, like library & computer lab only. For newcomers, I have mentioned that the gym is there, but its of no use for most of you because ...

reviews.review_heading: The college is excellent, you should take admission.
reviews.review_text: There are so many labs, classrooms, and a central library for study from morning to late night. The quality of the facilities in my hostel is very neat and clean. The quality and taste of food is hygienic and acceptable. There is a playground for games and a sports complex for sports.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good for studying.
reviews.review_text: About 5-6 acres of land are covered for the college campus, and there are labs and classrooms separately for every department for study. There is a central library for study. The quality of facilities in my hostel is very good. There is an RO water cooler for drinking purposes, a playground for outdoor games, and a sports complex for indoor games. The quality and taste of food in my mess are acceptable and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very relevant for placement purposes.
reviews.review_text: In my college, there is a central library for study purposes, and there are many labs and classrooms in each department for their purpose. There is also a whole LAN and Wi-Fi connection. The quality of the hostel is very good, neat, and clean. The food in the mess and canteen is reliable to eat and hygienic. There is a dispensary for medical purposes as well.

reviews.review_heading: SGSITS is a good option for Madhya Pradesh college level counselling.
reviews.review_text: There are spacious classrooms for lectures and other academic purposes. Departmental labs for various disciplines, including civil, chemistry computer, electrical, electronics, mechanical, and physics. A central library with a vast collection of books, journals (print and online), and reference materials. There are four boys' hostels with a total capacity for 600 students. There are three girls' hostels with a capacity for 467 students. Wi-Fi is available, and security is ensured with 24/7 guard...

reviews_list.review_title: Not absolutely satisfied, I am somewhat dissatisfied.

review_content.Placements: Above 50% students are placed in our course. The highest package offered is above 50000 INR and the lowest package is 38000 INR. The course makes us ready for the roles of nutritionist and dietician. So far, I think we don't have any recruiting companies, because mostly jobs are offered by hospitals. review_content.Infrastructure: All the classes and the departments are good. They are maintained neat presently, but they are getting old. Hostel has very poor facilities with washrooms being dirty and the corridors are not clean either. They include money for Wi-Fi in our fees, but they do not provide it. Labs are very good but sometimes the lab assistant is not available. During the practicals, they take money to give our records and they event take money for stamping.

reviews_list.review_title: A really good college for the faculty and facilities.

content.Placements: 100% of students are placed. The salary offered ranges between Rs. 30,000 - Rs. 50,000. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Amazon, C3I, Cognizant, and HGS. The roles offered by these companies are in customer support. Over 75% of students got internships from our course. The highest package is 4 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: All necessary facilities are available. The food provided in the hostel is average. We have access to facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, an auditorium, two AV rooms, a doctor, and a pleasant campus. There are sports activities, NSS, NCC, and various clubs like English literature and Hindi that organize different events related to their clubs.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Not absolutely satisfied, I am somewhat dissatisfied.

content.Placements: Above 50% students are placed in our course. The highest package offered is above 50000 INR and the lowest package is 38000 INR. The course makes us ready for the roles of nutritionist and dietician. So far, I think we don't have any recruiting companies, because mostly jobs are offered by hospitals. We get internships in well known hospitals. Nutritionist and dietician are the roles offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: All the classes and the departments are good. They are maintained neat presently, but they are getting old. Hostel has very poor facilities with washrooms being dirty and the corridors are not clean either. They include money for Wi-Fi in our fees, but they do not provide it. Labs are very good but sometimes the lab assistant is not available. During the practicals, they take money to give our records and they event take money for stamping.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: A really good college for the faculty and facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It was a really good experience at VGU.

content.Placements: In my batch, there were almost 25 students in CSE. Out of them, maybe 12 students got placement. Other students themselves find jobs or internships through various job portals. The highest package was 30 LPA in my batch. Companies like TCS and medium-scale companies were hiring.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the course was good, and college life was better. In my opinion, I got an opportunity to get involved with various students from foreign countries. It was amazing sharing thoughts with them. There is good hostel life. According to the packages of the course, you can choose a hostel room according to the 1 seater, 2 seater, and so on.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A wonderful college, Vivekanand Global University Jaipur, Rajasthan. Definitely check this out.

content.Placements: The number of students placed in my course is about 66 out of 110, and this is a good ratio, we can say. The highest package is 36 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package is 10 LPA. The top recruiters are Amazon, Deloitte, TCS, Zomato, and many more. About 65 percent got internships from the 3rd year onwards, and to good companies as well. Top roles are as a junior software engineer and assistant professor.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is pretty cool, and it gives a proper environment to study, but the infrastructure of the hostel is not that good. The main problem is hostel food. You have to manage food there. Otherwise, everything is okay. The canteen is also there, and you can find almost everything of your choice, from food to fast food. Also, there is a wonderful gym where you can build yourself strong, and medical facilities are also available. Wi-Fi works amazingly in college.

reviews.review_heading: It was a really good experience at VGU.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the course was good, and college life was better. In my opinion, I got an opportunity to get involved with various students from foreign countries. It was amazing sharing thoughts with them. There is good hostel life. According to the packages of the course, you can choose a hostel room according to the 1 seater, 2 seater, and so on.

reviews.review_heading: A wonderful college, Vivekanand Global University Jaipur, Rajasthan. Definitely check this out.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is pretty cool, and it gives a proper environment to study, but the infrastructure of the hostel is not that good. The main problem is hostel food. You have to manage food there. Otherwise, everything is okay. The canteen is also there, and you can find almost everything of your choice, from food to fast food. Also, there is a wonderful gym where you can build yourself strong, and medical facilities are also available. Wi-Fi works amazingly in college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities & infrastructure in my college are so good. The college has fully furnished classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, separate computer labs, and a library with a quiet environment and a lot of books. The hostel facilities and the quality of food are so good. The college has one-tier, two-tier & three-tier hostel rooms with fans, coolers & ACs with RO purified water. college_info.intro:
The National Power Training Institute (NPTI) offers a range of Management courses with its flagship programme being the NPTI MBA programme which is offered in affiliation with the J C Bose University of Science and Technology and has been approved by the AICTE.
The MBA programme is offered in one specialisation or Power Management, for a duration of two years with course curriculum emphasises a balanced approach with approximately 70% focus on General Management and 30% on Power and specialised topics. Students are taught through Seminars and Guest Lectures along with Live Project trainings in a way that integrates theory with real-world challenges to enhance both managerial and technical skills of students.
In the first year, students engage in core subjects such as Human Resources, Operations, Finance & Accounting, Marketing, and Information Technology, alongside essential power sector topics. The second year allows for specialisation in areas including Sustainability, Data Science and Data Analytics, Cybersecurity and Cloud.

content.Infrastructure: All the basic amenities are provided by our college in our department, such as a central library with all types of informative books and a good, studious, silent environment to study. Wi-Fi facilities are also provided all over the campus, including in classrooms and libraries. Classrooms are pretty big, and each classroom has projectors for visual learners. The infrastructure of our college is very lush, green, and peaceful. For hostel students, facilities like the mess are provided to have lunch. They provide healthy food every day, which is not expensive and is very affordable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college itself isn't too bad; however, it was not my first pick.

content.Placements: Placements in SB Jain are very difficult to crack. There are minimal and low-level recruiting companies that come to the campus to provide jobs. If you want a job, it is suggested to get one off-campus. There are still companies which come to SB Jain for placement, and last year, there were students who secured a 12 LPA package from SB Jain.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty good. Since I joined the college in 2022, it has been improving a lot, especially from the inside. SB Jain has two big grounds for students to play on and a big parking lot, etc. About the canteen, the food isn't too great. Sports events are organized for students. Labs are 6/10, and the Wi-Fi speed is lower than a snail. The library is pretty good, and classrooms are average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: S B Jain Institute of Technology, Management & Research - College Review.

content.Placements: I am currently in my third year. The placement preparation for outer campus is more skilled here. I belong to artificial intelligence and machine learning. I am from the very second batch here. Most of our seniors got placed in various companies from campus placements. The highest salary package offered this year is 8 LPA. Roles offered are data analyst, full-stack developer, and software developer. Also, 100% of students got internships from the college itself.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The college is spread over 13 acres of land. The library and classroom facilities are good. reviews.review_text: Campus has spacious classrooms with projectors, Wi-Fi, updated computer labs, and large library, hostels secure accommodation, decent mess food, medical aid, and good sports facilities. It has grounds and gym. It ensures a supportive, academic, and living environment.

reviews.review_heading: A really good college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at the campus are good; Wi-Fi is available. The canteen offers healthy food, and medical facilities are provided. Classrooms are fully modern. The institute provides grounds and courts for cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, and lawn tennis, as well as a swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are pretty strict but good.
reviews.review_text: All the basic amenities are provided by our college in our department, such as a central library with all types of informative books and a good, studious, silent environment to study. Wi-Fi facilities are also provided all over the campus, including in classrooms and libraries. Classrooms are pretty big, and each classroom has projectors for visual learners. The infrastructure of our college is very lush, green, and peaceful. For hostel students, facilities like the mess are provided to have lun...

reviews.review_heading: The college itself isn't too bad; however, it was not my first pick.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. Since I joined the college in 2022, it has been improving a lot, especially from the inside. SB Jain has two big grounds for students to play on and a big parking lot, etc. About the canteen, the food isn't too great. Sports events are organized for students. Labs are 6/10, and the Wi-Fi speed is lower than a snail. The library is pretty good, and classrooms are average.

reviews.review_heading: S B Jain Institute of Technology, Management & Research - College Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The college is spread over 13 acres of land. The library and classroom facilities are good. They have Wi-Fi but the signal strength is very weak. But HOD sir from our department supports us well. He guides us in various activities like ACM-ICPC, NPTEL Swayam, GATE, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good, but regarding placements, there is no guarantee.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is fine for the college. But it can be better according to the needs of the college. The Wi-Fi provided is free and accessible to all, but it does not run at very good speed. The mess is not provided by the college. The canteen is good in the college. Sports are not done often.

reviews.review_heading: A college with poor placements. It focuses only on academics.
reviews.review_text: All necessary facilities are available, but not more than that. Sports are not promoted in this college. There is no Wi-Fi here. Our classrooms are average. The library is small and average. In summer, college feels like we're in an oven. That's all from my side.

reviews.review_heading: Has really good Infrastructure and environment to study and grow ourselves .
reviews.review_text: There are many useful facilities that are available in our department such as Wi-Fi, Labs of different practical tests, library in which books are available for all the courses, water filters and coolers. The quality of food in canteen is moderately good and the most important medical facilities are there as well.

reviews.review_heading: College is good and campus is very nice.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very good and the faculty is very nice. Facilities are good, including the lab, classroom, and library. In electrical engineering, computer lab monitor needs to be replaced. The college hostel is good, the food quality is decent, the medical facilities are good and the sports facilities need improvement. And college didn't support you in sports if the exam and sports match were on the same day.

reviews.review_heading: Barely any placements, no college & no growth in skills due to poor crowd.
reviews.review_text: There was no Wi-Fi until last year; now there is Wi-Fi but with no signal. No grass on the football field; we don't have access to a swimming pool; the food in the canteen is good & reasonable. The labs in the college are alright, the library is good, & there is a sports cell for equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for IT placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, including the lab, classroom, and library. In electrical engineering, computer lab monitors need to be replaced. The college hostel is good, the food quality is decent, the medical facilities are good and the sports facilities need improvement. And college didn't support you in sports if the exam and sports match were on the same day. They should give a chance to sports students to write that exam later; they directly put zero. I had seen that in the unit test exam.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with 2024 batch placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: The facilities for the mess are available and well-structured. Wi-Fi is available in every department, and there are well-equipped classrooms and a well-equipped library with all books available. This college does not provide hostel facilities, and the quality of the canteen food is amazing. All sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of S B Jain Institute of Technology, Management and Research.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the canteen is very good and healthy. It provides a variety of food items like South Indian, Chinese, etc. Our college provides facilities for sports and games like volleyball, cricket, etc. Our college has a separate ground for sports and other activities.

reviews.review_heading: If you have a score of 70 to 80% in 12th grade, this college is for you.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, as the geological location of our college is perfect for a place to study and develop your skills, and the best parts are sunsets, ventilation, and the fact that they clean the premises in every 10 minutes. The clean environment and the fact that food and water are provided are unquestionable.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend students take admission to S B Jain College.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are not available. You have to take rooms in nearby places.

faqs.question: What is the fee refund policy at IILM Lucknow?
faqs.answer: The fee refund policy of IILM Academy of Higher Learning, Lucknow is as per AICTE rules. The institute refunds all the deposited amount by the student who wish to withdraw on or before the date of commencement of classes after deducting a processing fee of INR 1,000. reviews.review_heading: Great college for PGDM in Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not that great but the building facilities are up to the mark and provide all the basic needs that a PGDM college should provide. There is Wi-Fi in the labs for internet access. The library has enough management reference books and textbooks. Canteen is small and not spacious. There are all the essentials available such as medical, emergency etc. There is no ground or court for games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am  satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are very good and well designed. Hostel facilities are also very good. The canteen of the college is average but not so good. But other facilities are good.  Classrooms are well designed with modern teaching techniques.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: IILM provides the best learning platform. There is the best library on our campus with many books. All types of books and magazines are available. They provide weekly newspaper brand equity. The canteen is good and the food serviced is also very good. They serve good, healthy, and tasty food. The hostel is very furnished and fine for both girls and boys. Hostels for boys and girls are separated.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good to study and improve from basic to higher knowledge, along with fun.
reviews.review_text: Our college has very good facilities and infrastructure. Many things are available in our college like Wi-Fi, labs, fabulous classrooms and library. Our college doesn't provide hostels, but it helps to search for a hostel or PG. The quality of the food served is good.

reviews.review_heading: IILM provides a platform to students for enhancing their overall development.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms were provided with AC. The campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Labs were provided to the students. The canteen was cheap and fits to each student pocket. The food was good. Different department was made and committee was there to look to canteen, and other activities like sports medical etc.

reviews.review_heading: A good college to study, explore and develop yourself.
reviews.review_text:
We have a library, canteen, Wi-Fi and a lab
For sports, we have volleyball, badminton, Cricket net practise etc.
Although the college campus is not that big but keeping this in mind we have lots of options to play and study. Canteen food is good and the mess is clean.

reviews.review_heading: Quite satisfied because of cooperative faculty, good placements and ROI.
reviews.review_text: We have modern classrooms with AC, wi-fi connectivity all over, computer labs, auditorium, library with a variety of books, table tennis area, good canteen food and hostel facility is also available at a reasonable cost. Sports games like volleyball, badminton can be also played.

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing college with well-qualified faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good and well maintained. Facilities like classrooms, Wi-Fi, labs, library and canteen are available. Hostels facilities are well, and it is nearby the college with all facilities, including medical facilities, sports and games. The college conducts different games for students to be team player.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with minimum fees.
reviews.review_text: The college has quite comfortable and clean classrooms, and other areas are also clean. Only the college canteen is very small for students to stay. Seating arrangements in the classrooms should be changed as some have really worn off and are at the last stage. Rest all other things well here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IILM Academy of Higher Learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is the same as other management colleges, and the buildings are good with the red-brick walls. The college also has air-conditioned classrooms, and all the classrooms are equipped with projectors. We have an amphitheatre to conduct the annual fest and other activities. There is an auditorium available for formal events and educational seminars.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure as well as good faculty members. Perfect place for your future career. It is situated in heart of the city. Every year conduct zeal programme in this programme student participate and win prizes. Hostel was good. Canteen is awesome. They serve delicious food in average price.

reviews.review_heading: A great place to learn and shape your future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is simple, yet elegant. There is an open campus with proper ventilation. The college provides all the basic requirements like an auditorium, spacious canteen and lecture halls with projectors. Gallery classrooms are present. Parking facility is good. There is a garden behind the college. Computer lab, CDC room, library and amphitheatre are provided for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is worth the money with a supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite beautiful, and like the other top-notch management colleges, it has everything which a college needs. The best thing is its amphitheatre which is beautiful and well-equipped. The infrastructure is spacious, airy with a beautiful corridor, and during the events, they are well decorated.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for masters degree (MBA & PGDM).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. The building of the college is having the ventilated classrooms and the computer labs. The campus has the ground for playing games like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, etc. It has a good canteen for food which provides hygienic food for four times a day. The hostel rooms are good with proper lighting and ventilation.
