individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: IBA- Making a future of us.

content.Placements: The top recruiting companies last year were TCS, KPMG, and PwC. Since I'm in my first year right now, we don't have placements. But last year, around 80 percent of students got campus placements. The highest package was 22 lacs, and the average package was 8 lacs. An internship is compulsory for everyone.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was available only on the laptop provided by the college. The classrooms were recently furnished so they're good. The hostel is okay; it is a bit old so all the things are a bit old. The quality of the food was good, but sometimes it was oily. The library is very huge and good.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I can recommend others to take admission in this college.

content.Placements: This college offers specialisations in finance, marketing, HR, business analytics, and international business. Any two domains can be chosen for your specialisation. 95% of the students in the 21-23rd batch are placed. Deloitte, PwC, Bizdata, Reckitt, Aditya Birla, Reliance, ICICI Bank, securities, prudential, etc. companies came for placement.
content.Infrastructure: For a two-year course, there are six trimesters and a three-month internship period. During this time, you can learn practical knowledge, work ethics, time management, etc. It's a vegan campus. Non-vegetarian foods are not permitted on campus. In the mess, they provide breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college is known for its diversity and uniqueness.

content.Placements: Top recruiting companies are Colgate, Palmolive, Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Federal Bank, etc. The placement rate of our college is 90%. Our college provides good internship opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is spread over 9 acres of land. The infrastructure of our campus is good. It has good facilities like a library with great collection of books, a gym, and separate classrooms for all blocks. Our college provides 24X7 Wi-Fi. The hostel facility is good. It has spacious rooms.
content.Faculty: Our college has many experienced faculty members. They help with our doubts and assignments. Our mentors guide us and give us proper direction to make certain decisions. They guide us in our ups and down in these two years of the course.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The campus is good, and mentors are assigned to each student to guide them.

content.Placements: Our college provides good placements. Top recruiting companies visit our campus. The average salary package offered is 6 LPA to 7 LPA. Top companies like big 4 companies come to our campus to recruit students of specialisations like finance, marketing, business analysis, human resources, logistics, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a friendly environment. There are separate boys' and girls' hostels. We have a mess, an IT department, a library, an admin block, an amphitheater, an auditorium, a placement room, 12 classrooms, and a gym. There is a volleyball court, a basketball court, a place for indoor games, and a small grocery shop.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: It is an awesome and great college to develop your skills and come out of your comfort zone.

content.Placements: The placements in our college are very good. The college provides industry exposure, training in presentations skills and management skills, lectures from IIM faculty, and personality development classes for students. Business analytics, international business, finance, HR, operations, and marketing are offered here, but you have to choose any 2 of these, where marketing is constant for all.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is superb here. If you get to go to this college, it will surely change your life and lifestyle way better than you have dreamt. It is a great college. It helps you become a corporate professional. You can achieve your dreams if you work hard in these 2 years.

Application Process
Candidates meeting the eligibility can fill the application form online at the website of the institute. You have to pay an application fee and upload some documents to complete the process.
Selection Rounds

Admission Confirmation

review_content.Placements: Around 20% of the students got placed from college, and the rest joined for MBA or job. reviews_list.review_title: Truth about management courses from a Reputed college.

review_content.Placements: I was student of batch 2016-19 for the course of BBA. Placement department is very hardworking and helpful. reviews_list.review_title: Good faculty members, good atmosphere to study.

review_content.Placements: Placements in Amity are pretty impressive and good. Because we've SAP and SIP while pursuing our degree that is Summer assignment and project and Summer internship programme. reviews_list.batch_info: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration (GDBA) + Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: An amazing journey with learning and discovering oneself with the help of Amity.

review_content.Placements: The placements are fine till date. There are a lot of companies who have visited my college from Amazon to Lear Corporation and many. review_summary.college_name: SAGE University powered by Sunstone (Indore) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Marketing Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with faculty members and management.

content.Placements: Faculty members are nice and supportive with academics as well as placement and internship guidance. Top recruiting companies are Infosys, Tata, etc. Internships and placements are based on attendance as well. There is a 100% placement guarantee if our attendance is more than 75% each semester.
content.Infrastructure: Library is above average. Canteen is very small in our department, it's better in Computer Science department. Hostels are average, they have a curfew after 8:00 PM. Food is also average in the canteen, mess food is somewhat better. Infrastructure is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with my college.

content.Placements: Recently, students got placed on their good performance. Many companies offered internships and placements to students. The average salary package offered is around 6 LPA. It is good for a fresher. It will be improved in some time and have amazing placement results.
content.Infrastructure: The food is good. The infrastructure is 10/10. Facilities in the hostel are very good. The hostel provides medical support. The hostel is clean and has a good environment. There are amazing students. There is parental support. All facilities are available in hostels.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Marketing Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The academic experience at Sunstone and State University of Indore is decent.

content.Placements: College offers a 100% guaranteed placements. The highest salary package offered is 13 LPA. The average salary package offered is 6 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, KPMG, and Infosys. Around 80% of students from our course secured internships in Infosys, Kotak, and TCS. Top roles offered are Data Analyst, HR, Marketing, Business Manager, Resource Manager, SEO Specialist, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Library is decent with relevant books available for each course. Our college has a different building for each course and a separate floor for Sunstone. Quality of food is average. Medical facilities and sports and games are below average. Infrastructure is huge. There are dedicated libraries for each course.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Operations and Supply Chain Management - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Sunstone Eduversity (SAGE) is the best in all attributes.

content.Placements: Sunstone Eduversity has dedicated placement team members who work round the clock to get me and my fellow batchmates placed. The placement system is in such a way that I could attend interviews in companies in which I was interested. Even I got job offers from 2 out of 3 companies. I am thankful to Sunstone for building my career to have success.
content.Infrastructure: SAGE, Indore, has an amazing campus with green surroundings and vast spaces. There is a cafeteria to hang out and spend time relaxing. The campus is well facilitated with labs, a 24x7 library, air-conditioners, hostel, transport and everything which students could need in MBA.

paragraphs: SAGE University powered by Sunstone (Indore), trains its students for a variety of job profiles through more than 100 hours of job-focused boot camps. To ensure that the placement-centric sessions are completed successfully, the University's placement team also monitors the dynamic changes occurring globally.

As per the latest report, the highest and average package offered during SAGE University Powered by Sunstone placements in 2025 stood at INR 26 LPA and INR 4.6 LPA, respectively. More than 1,200 companies visited the campus in 2025 and provided jobs in over 50 domains . The top recruiters of SAGE University Powered by Sunstone (Indore) in 2025 included Nestle, Amul, Paytm, SBI General, Axis Bank, Muthoot Finance, HDFC Life, Coca-Cola, Zomato, Grow, Wipro, Paisabazar, and many more. In 2025, the ROI was 63% higher.

Sunstone’s Placement Opportunity Program (POP) offers students access to 200+ assured placement opportunities, or a refund of their first-year tuition fee if placements don’t meet the commitment. To be eligible for POP, students must maintain a minimum average attendance of 70% across all credit and non-credit classes in every semester. They are also required to clear all examinations with a minimum score of 80% or equivalent CGPA, and must not have any backlogs. In addition, students must ensure that all fee payments are made as per the timeline outlined in the offer letter. Lastly, students must strictly adhere to the Sunstone Placement Policy Guidelines throughout the program

BMSIT Bangalore offers 10+ UG and PG-level courses with BE as their flagship course and NIRF ranking of 151-200. BMSIT BE course offers 10 specializations with a total of 1920 seats for a 4-year program. Apart from that, the eligibility criteria involve entrance results of KCET/ COMED-K/ Diploma CET. The SC/ST/OBC category aspirants receive a 5% relaxation in the aggregate for admission.

admission_overview.description: BMSIT admission 2025 is entrance-based for some courses while merit-based for others. It accepts scores of certain entrance exams such as PGCET, KCET, etc. BMSIT offers various courses at the UG and PG levels in affiliation with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi. The institute also offers PhD and MSc (Engineering) courses. Interested candidates can apply for admission on the official website.

eligibility_selection.title: BMSIT Eligibility & Selection 2025
eligibility_selection.description: BMSIT offers UG and PG courses in full-time mode. Aspirants need to fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria to apply for admission. review_content.Placements: Placements at the university are decent, as 70-80 percent of students got placed last year. The average package is 5 LPA, and the maximum package is 84 LPA. Companies like TCS, Amazon, and Wipro visit the campus for placements. The university also provides internship opportunities to students to make them ready for the industry. Companies provide roles like software developer, game developer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the university is quite decent, as it only has a few buildings for courses like B.Tech agriculture and mass communication. For major courses like B.Tech. and BCA, the campus is limited within a single building with multiple floors. It only has a single elevator, which makes it difficult to reach class on time. The university also has hostel facilities for students who are not from Dehradun, which makes it easy to settle in the environment. The quality of food in the mess is decent, as it is neither that good nor that bad.

paragraphs: Admission to Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun is based on merit of the qualifying examination for most of the courses.GEHU Dehradun admission processstarts with checking the eligibility followed by qualifying for entrance tests, selection, and admission confirmation. Interested students can follow the steps below to complete theGraphic Era Hill University, Dehradunadmission process:
GEHU Application Process

The admission process of Graphic Era Hill University starts with filling the application form available on the official website of the university with all the required details such as personal details, Educational details etc., and uploading scanned copies of relevant documents. After the application form is completed, candidates are advised to recheck all the details before submission.
GEHU Selection Rounds

GEHU admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For merit-based admission, candidates have to submit the scores in the last qualifying exams of their previous education & entrance exam scores for the respective course.
The university conducts an in-house entrance-cum-scholarship test - GECET. Students can choose to either appear for the test or submit scores of other accepted national-level exams.
Admission Confirmation

After getting shortlisted for the respective course, candidates need to pay theGraphic Era Hill University Dehradun feesto confirm their admission to the university. After fee submission, the university will provide a provisional allotment letter, along with the class commencement information.

review_content.General: My department had decent Wi-Fi, well-maintained labs, and classrooms with projectors. The library was helpful for reference books and quiet study. The hostel facilities were average but manageable, with regular cleaning and basic amenities. Mess food was simple and sometimes repetitive, but the canteen offered better options. We had a small medical room for basic issues, and the campus had grounds for cricket, volleyball, and indoor games.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: You can go to this college only if your EAMCENT rank is low or if you are going for management seat.

review_content.Placements: 80%-90% of students got placed from this college. The highest package is around 24 LPA, the lowest package is around 2 LPA, and the average package in this college is around 6 LPA-7 LPA. Recruiting companies such as Microsoft, Accenture, Tata, etc. 35%-45% of students offered internship opportunities. CSE, ECE, EEE, and specializations in CSE are the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities in this college are quite impressive. For every course, there is a certified faculty. The Wi-Fi of the college provides good and fast internet to compile code faster. Labs look quite impressive and professional. Classrooms provide ventilation to each class. There are multiple libraries that students can access easily. The main disappointment is that there is no hostel in this college. Though they are building it now, it may be completed in the year 2027. Every year, they conduct a sports fest. We play with other colleges and also among ourselves.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Our college had the best faculty and staff, and there were many facilities as well.

review_content.Placements: Almost 70 percent of students from our course got placed in campus placements in top companies. The highest package was 5.5 LPA, the average package was 3 LPA, and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies included Foxconn, COULRYT, and 24/7 AI. Approximately 53 percent of students completed their internships in companies like Software IT Solutions and Arky Technology Pvt. Ltd. The top roles were Network Planning Engineer and Electronic Design Engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was absolutely satisfying for students. Facilities were very reasonable. Facilities included AC labs, seminar halls, a library, free Wi-Fi around the entire campus, and other resources. Facilities provided by the hostel were also great for students, with good and neat rooms and tasty food available in the canteen and mess at reasonable prices. Games like cricket, volleyball, and basketball were played regularly in the college. The medical facilities were available throughout the day.

review_content.Placements: 50% of students passed in the academic year 2024-2025 from B.Tech CSE, with the highest package offered being around 5 to 7 LPA. Top companies like TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Amazon, Capgemini, Deloitte, Bitwise, and many startups visit the campus. Around 60% of students got internships, and top roles included software development engineer, full stack developer, back-end engineer, software tester, data analyst, and python developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-class compared to other colleges in Kolhapur, with a decent environment, greenery, cleanliness, sanitation, modern classrooms, and well-equipped laboratories. Hostel rooms are good with 4 beds each and plenty of rooms, maintaining proper cleanliness and comfort. Offering a good environment for self-study with a natural view outside the windows. Food quality is decent, though the monthly mess fee is around 3500, medical facilities are top-notch, and sports are arranged and conducted nicely every year, enjoyed by students, with separate facilities for kabaddi, football, cricket, volleyball, and basketball.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good campus life and decent placements, but still needs improvements.

content.Placements: In our course at SGU, around 40%-45% of eligible students secure campus placements each year (for example, in 2023- 24, out of 218 graduation and undergraduate students, only 90 were placed). The highest package offered recently has been up to 36 LPA for select students. The average (or median) package for many batches is in the range of 2 to 4 LPA (for example: median for UG 3-year was 2.4 LPA and for 4-year - 3.6 LPA). The lowest offers reported were around 2 to 2.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has decent facilities overall. We get full campus Wi-Fi most of the time. Labs are well equipped for normal practical and coding work, and classrooms have projectors and enough seating. The library has a good collection for CSE, but honestly, it gets crowded during exam time. Hostel facilities are okay, not perfect, but manageable. Rooms are clean, but sometimes maintenance takes time. Mess food is average, some days it is good, and some days it is just normal, so students mostly depend on canteen snacks. Medical facilities on campus are available and helpful during emergencies.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college has great learning environment with supportive faculty.

content.Placements: A good percentage is required, but a student with good skills is more important in my opinion. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Students having good knowledge of problem-solving can pass the interviews. There are many roles offered, but it's up to us what we prefer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good and beautiful. The hostel is clean and great. Infrastructure consists of a lake, trees, gardens, statues, and much more. There is free Wi-Fi, clean labs, and larger classrooms. The library consists of different types of books. It has been a great experience.

admission_overview.college_name: Sanjay Ghodawat University Admission 2025: Application Process, Eligibility, Courses & Fee

paragraphs: Sanjay Ghodawat University (SGU) offers more than 60 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes in Technology, Architecture, Commerce & Management, Science, Computer Science & Applications, Liberal Arts, and Pharmaceutical Sciences. SGU accepts the applications in the online mode. Admission to various courses at the university is merit-based or entrance exam-based.

Apart from these courses, the university also provides financial support to students basis their academic merit and entrance exam scores. Also, SGU provides several job opportunities to students across various courses through campus placement drives where recruiters like Amazon, ICICI Bank, Infosys, and Wipro participate.

Merit in the last qualifying examination is the basic eligibility for various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes offered at Sanjay Ghodawat University. However, admission to these courses is based on the scores obtained by the candidates in national, state, or university-level entrance exams. The table below lists various courses offered at SGU along with their application status, eligibility, and fee details:
Class 12 with 45% aggregate
JEE/ MHTCET/PERA CET
Class 12 with PCM/ Diploma
NATA/ JEE Main Paper II
Bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate
CAT/MAT/XAT/ GMAT/ATMA/CMAT/ PERA CET
Class 12 with 45% aggregate
NEET/MHTCET
BE/ BTech with 45% aggregate
GATE/ PERA CET
BCA or equivalent degree with 50% aggregate
MAH-MCA-CET
Bachelor's degree from a recognised university
Master's degree

The admission procedure for Sanjay Ghodawat University involves multiple steps, such as appearing for the accepted entrance exam, application, selection, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission must fulfil all of the required admission criteria before applying. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailedSanjay Ghodawat University admissions process:
Step 1: Sanjay Ghodawat University Application Process 2025

Sanjay Ghodawat University's admission processstarts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at Sanjay Ghodawat University. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the UG and PG courses at Sanjay Ghodawat University is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as SGUPET for the selection of respective courses.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats.

reviews.review_text: Hostels are not provided you have to rent a private hostel or PG and that's a major drawback of the college. There is a separate hostel for girls but that too was closed around 7 years ago. So this is also the major drawback even though it's the best college of Allahabad University.

reviews.review_heading: The best college with good faculty, big ground, labs, library, worth of money, and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: My college has the best library with a digital library, good sports facilities, and big classrooms with projectors where required. Toilets are clean, and regular competitions, along with NCC and NSS, are available for students. RO water is provided in the summer, and there are specialized teachers and computer labs.

reviews.review_heading: About the college and its staff members.
reviews.review_text: There are better labs, but the lab in charge is very bad in biotech and botany courses. They do not say anything easily. They speak all the time like judges. They are not good. Many students are suffering in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Students should take admission to the ECC college, it is best.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a wide range of facilities. Labs are very good. Classrooms are also very good. Library is awesome but college should work on the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Not too good but considerable for student who just want to study only without any college life.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility provided by this college. Private hostels and PGs are available which provide facilities with an average budget of Rs 10,000.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, better facilities.
reviews.review_text: Proper lab facilities with smart boards, Wi-Fi, and a library. There are many sports facilities like badminton, cricket, football, and many other games. They always organize tech fests for college students, and other colleges also participate in this.

reviews.review_heading: "Revitalizing Excellence: A Comprehensive Review of Wing Christian College."
reviews.review_text: ECC offers a robust academic and research environment for its Biophysics Department, which operates within the Department of Physics. The department has well-equipped laboratories and a dedicated project room, all complemented by a workshop. Specialized research labs, such as the Biophysics Lab, Radon Tradition Lab, and Liquid Crystal Lab, enhance the department's research capabilities. There is no hostel facility to be offered, and there is no mess or a canteen. There are no medical facilities....

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are good but there are no placements.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is good and clean. Sports facilities are available but there is no hostel. There is no cafeteria. The fee here is quite low as it is a government college of University of Allahabad. Wi-Fi is provided in the college but its speed is quite low. There is a laboratory in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: They provide course for B.Sc. M.Sc. B.A. BCA and many more. The classrooms are well maintained and provide smart classrooms. Wi-Fi is available in library and the library is also well maintained. They have post graduate labs of Physics and Chemistry.

reviews.review_heading: An awesome journey of 3 years which I will miss whole life.
reviews.review_text: There is availability of Wi-Fi, library, separate study room, labs are very good, and sports club, gym, canteen, all grounds and garden, and best availability of sitting. There are also facilities for water cooler and other, and the campus is very well maintained and cleaned, which you can see.

reviews.review_heading: The experience at campus is very good,and completely satisfied with faculties and teachers
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, facilities are very engaging, wifi is always available for students. Classrooms are big and library is very peaceful, full of books available for you. The facilities in hostel is well, they provide best quality of food, sports like cricket, badminton, football, and other games like chess etc are available for student to participate in.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely Thrilled and Satisfied with the Overall Management of the College
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure always gives a sense of British times, as this college was built during the colonial period and was once run by the British. The college has great infrastructure, with each subject having its own department and separate building, all painted in red and white. The campus is full of greenery with three gardens that enhance the beauty of the college. It was an all-girls college. Classrooms are equipped with projectors, and there are three libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Overall if someone wants to take admission, he or she can.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is also average. We don’t have a lot of facilities in the college, but we do have an average auditorium and a good library. There is a hostel facility for girls, and we have a mess in our college where the food is good. The classrooms are well-furnished.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college in this city.
reviews.review_text: The college's facilities are well maintained and made available to its students. The campus is well maintained and very big; all the departments are on campus. There is no hostel at this college but all other activities are done there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Central University of Haryana and education.

content.Placements: About 70 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 28 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies are electrical companies that like RR cables, etc. About 28 percent of students got internships in companies like RR Cables and Tata Electric.
content.Infrastructure: In the infrastructure engineering development stage, the departments are very good. Wi-Fi labs and classrooms are very brilliant. The quality of education is very good the facilities in hostels are not so good. We have to take PG other than the hostel, thank you.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My review of this college.

content.Placements: Around 50 percent of the students got placed in the course. The highest package was 17 LPA, and the lowest was around 3 LPA. The companies that visited the campus were Delloite, Wipro, TCS, Adani, etc. The college offered good placement opportunities for students interested in getting themselves employed. Most of the job descriptions were for the role of SDE, which consists of FTE + internship. Internships started in January in the last semester. As soon as the course was over, students joined for their full-time. Companies conducted interview sections for placement selection and for the package.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: This is a good college in Haryana for an M.A. in Economics.

content.Placements: 95% of students got placed in India and abroad. The median placement was modest, around 2.8–4.89 lakhs per month, which was a prestigious salary for a student. The companies where students got placed were HDFC Bank, ICICI, TCS, IBM, Microsoft, and Infosys. Every year, these companies visit the college campus, and students get placed.
content.Infrastructure: The college had a big library and provided all study materials free of cost. All classrooms were smart classrooms and provided Wi-Fi 24/7 across the college campus. The college had an auditorium. The campus had college hostels. They were price-friendly. The campus also had a canteen, and they provided good-quality food.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Nutrition Biology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Affordable fees, but the remote location is a significant drawback for an active social life.

content.Placements: Placements are definitely a mixed bag. While top students in core tech/commerce departments land solid packages, many courses lack consistent, high-quality on-campus recruitment opportunities, pushing students to find their own path or pursue higher studies. It's consistent at best.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is CUH's strong suit, modern AC classrooms, excellent labs, a massive library, and reliable Wi-Fi. Hostels are generally decent with good facilities, though the quality of mess food is a recurring complaint, and securing a boys' hostel spot can be very competitive due to demand.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc.-M.Sc in Physics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Well, I would like to say that some of the departments are very good. Not all, so choose wisely.

content.Placements: My college took admission through a cutoff, and many students got good internships. The latest company, Lenskart, arrived in our college for placement, and student from B.com took seats in their company. Overall, I will say that it is quite good for placement, not too much better.
content.Infrastructure: Well, about Wi-Fi, I would say that it is good because it is present in the department as well as in the hostel. The hostels are also good. I would prefer the old hostel because there are 3 seats in a room for the old hostel, and there are 4 seats in a room for new students or in the new hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It offers affordable education with supportive faculty. Placement and location need Improvement.

The university has a health centre with basic medical services and a 24x7 ambulance. There is a large sports complex with facilities for various outdoor and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall, everything is good here.

content.Placements: Around 64% students got placed in campus placements, the remaining do businesses, startups and some of them were not eligible for campus placements due to low scores. And after all, it also depends on one's technical skills, if we are unable to deliver the required performance, then it's tough to get selected in campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but there are 3 colleges in SAL regarding engineering, Saliter, SCE, SETI, in which Saliter & SETI have their own building, but SCE is combined into SALITER and only in 2-4 classes have AC, while the other just have fans. Labs are good, they have AC, but there is only 1 library in between the whole 3 colleges, and college Wi-Fi is limited to labs only.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty members and decent placements with strong campus life and facilities.

content.Placements: Around 70 percent of students in our course got placed through campus placements. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is around 5.5 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini and L&T. Nearly 60 percent for the students got internships in companies like TCS, Cognizant and a few startups during their final year. Top roles offered software developer, data analyst, QA engineer and system administrator. Overall, the placement support and guidance from the faculty members are helpful especially for students who actively participated in training programs.

individual_reviews.title: Great college of engineering.

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates must have passed Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics, or equivalent with a minimum of 45% aggregate. In addition to this, students need to appear for TNEA counselling or the Single Window Admissions System. Single Window Admissions System is used in Anna University for TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admission). It is popularly known as Anna University Counselling and is part of the process via which students completing Class 12 apply and secure admission to Engineering colleges within Tamil Nadu. The important strategy is that the counselling is conducted based on rank list, if a student is present for counselling then without allocating a college and course for that student, next rank cannot be allocated with a seat.

review_summary.college_name: Coimbatore Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Construction Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Coimbatore Institute of Technology in M.E Construction Management course information

content.Placements: About 80 percent of the students can get jobs. The highest offer is 10 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is around 5.8 LPA. Companies like L&T, Tata Projects, and NCC are hiring a lot. There are a lot of good internship opportunities, mostly in site and project coordination.
content.Infrastructure: Campus has clean classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and labs for planning. There are a lot of books on engineering management in the library. The rooms in the hostel are clean, but the food is always the same. There is a sports field and medical help, but the service can be slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The placements were good at my college.

content.Placements: 85% students were placed in my course. 13.5 LPA is the highest package, 7.5 LPA is the average package, and 4 LPA is the lowest package. John Mathey, reliance recruited. 75% got an internship. Core-based and software-based roles are offered. My department faculty members were working sincerely on their work.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are very good. Wi-fi is available throughout the campus, and the labs are so good, all equipment is available in Physics and Chemistry labs. For separate departments, they have labs. Especially in my course, labs are large and have more facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good college if you are ready to learn by yourself.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed. The highest package is 24 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Top recruiting company is KLA. 60% of students got internships on campus interviews at companies like KLA, Thorogood, etc. Top roles offered are data and AI consultant, software engineer, data scientists, and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. There is no Wi-Fi in computing block for students access. Labs are clean. Library is easily accessible and good. Hostel and mess are good. Hostel mess is okay when you can adjust to the normal, minimal food that is not too tasty. Hostel rooms are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A peaceful life at Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: 97% of students were placed in good company. The other 3% choose to continue their studies to the next level. The siphon is also a little worth for the job. Top companies visit our college to recruit students. There are vast options to choose from for your placement.
content.Infrastructure: There are specific labs for each and every department. We also have a computer engineering lab with full-fledged. There is a Wi-Fi support in almost every computer. The hostel is neatly maintained by the hostel students and the appointed staff. The hostel is vast and sufficient.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is very good in terms of placements.

content.Placements: The top recruiters are Bosch, Deshaw, Toshiba, L&T, Hyundai, and many more. The highest package in the college is 52 LPA by Deshaw. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is around 5-6 LPA. Many other software companies also recruit from this college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent and not very fancy. Labs are good, and the systems are all functioning. The library functions from 9 AM to 7 PM except for Sunday. Canteens and chaat shops are available. The sports and athletics club is present. Sports like cricket, football, badminton, chess, and many more are available.

faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics, or equivalent with a minimum of 45% aggregate. It is popularly known as Anna University Counselling and is part of the process via which students completing Class 12 apply and secure admission to Engineering colleges within Tamil Nadu. The important strategy is that the counselling is conducted based on rank list, if a student is present for counselling then without allocating a college and course for that student, next rank cannot be allocated with a seat.

sports.description: CIT Coimbatore has the infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor spots to promote holistic development in the students. The sports centre has a football field, a hockey turf, an athletics track, a cricket ground, and volleyball courts. The indoor facilities include badminton, table tennis, chess, and carrom. reviews.review_heading: Coimbatore Institute of Technology in M.E Construction Management course information
reviews.review_text: Campus has clean classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and labs for planning. There are a lot of books on engineering management in the library. The rooms in the hostel are clean, but the food is always the same. There is a sports field and medical help, but the service can be slow.

reviews.review_heading: The placements were good at my college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are very good. Wi-fi is available throughout the campus, and the labs are so good, all equipment is available in Physics and Chemistry labs. For separate departments, they have labs. Especially in my course, labs are large and have more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college if you are ready to learn by yourself.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. There is no Wi-Fi in computing block for students access. Labs are clean. Library is easily accessible and good. Hostel and mess are good. Hostel mess is okay when you can adjust to the normal, minimal food that is not too tasty. Hostel rooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: A peaceful life at Coimbatore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: There are specific labs for each and every department. We also have a computer engineering lab with full-fledged. There is a Wi-Fi support in almost every computer. The hostel is neatly maintained by the hostel students and the appointed staff. The hostel is vast and sufficient.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent and not very fancy. Labs are good, and the systems are all functioning. The library functions from 9 AM to 7 PM except for Sunday. Canteens and chaat shops are available. The sports and athletics club is present. Sports like cricket, football, badminton, chess, and many more are available.

reviews.review_heading: Learning phase of the life.
reviews.review_text: 4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every piece of equipment that is needed for potential engineers but the infrastructure is old and outdated as the college was built in 1950s. The college recently started the renovating process, which is going on.

reviews.review_heading: A good place to gain knowledge and placements but has bad infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every lab equipment that is needed for a potential engineering but the infrastructure is old and the college has started the reconstruction of new buildings.
The hostel and the food provided are below average.

reviews.review_heading: Events .The college events conducted by the various clubs
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good.Rooms are allocated with 2 persons per room . It's fair spacious.considering campus life interacting with seniors makes it more interesting via club events and some department events.Sports are pretty good in out college.Our college contains various club so that every student can participate in any of the club activities .social service clubs like nss ,yrc,rsp etc are also here which taught students about the responsibilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel, classrooms, and placements record.
reviews.review_text:
We got a new block recently, especially for MSC integrated courses. Classrooms are good. The institute provides well-maintained facilities for sports like football, cricket, basketball, and tennis.
A modern gym equipped with cardio and weight-training equipment is accessible to students.

reviews.review_heading: Student driven clubs and the activities that gives students a boost up to their personality.
reviews.review_text: Our lab is completely a teach-ready lab, which is an important thing in every college. When it comes to sports, each sport has its own clubs, and the students and members actively participate in intercollegiate and all levels of sports and come out in shining colors.

reviews.review_heading: College is likely good and the infrastructure is peaceful.
reviews.review_text: Club involvement in the college is very good. They made a drama club for the students, a dance club for the students, a singing club for the students, and many more clubs. The martial arts club especially focuses on the girls safety. Every morning, 2 hours for the martial arts club and athletes in the sports clubs.

reviews.review_heading: I like the infrastructure and the campus very much.
reviews.review_text: There will be 28+ clubs in CIT, such as Rotaract, Nature Club, Literary Club, EBSB, KKC, MAC, and so on. The extracurricular activities are amazing, and there will be daily sports practice for football, volleyball, cricket, and so on. There will be good facilities in the classrooms for the students to enhance their knowledge. There will be huge benefits for the students due to their access to the library, and different fests will be conducted frequently.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with excellent placement records.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Computer labs have Wi-Fi facilities. The classrooms have smart boards, etc. The hostel's quality was mediocre. The food is like all other hostel food. We can't expect food to be great in hostel. We have a separate canteen where we have to pay eat.

reviews.review_heading: Coimbatore institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. There were some old buildings where the construction was going on. In labs, some of the equipments didn’t work. Our library is very big with all the academic books mase available along with a Wi-Fi and WLAN cable. I had some bad experiences with the hostel. There are no fans, I brought a fan for the room myself. They need to at least provide the basic facilities. Our mess food was moderate in quality. No medical facilities are given by the college.

reviews.review_heading: A place where you can sculpt yourself.
reviews.review_text: The lab is well-equipped with all necessary equipment. Smart classrooms provide an effective learning environment. The library is stocked with a variety of books, both core and non-core. Hostel infrastructure can be improved; however, the food is satisfactory. There are three dispensaries for medical support, and sports facilities are good.

reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely trash faculty here.

review_content.Placements: Our college is a great place to get your research skills upto the mark as it supports research-based studies more, and it encourages research more than the studies going on statistically in the classes. If you want to join my college, then come here if you have an interest in doing research.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel Wi-Fi is provided, and necessities like water and electricity are provided 24/7, but the food isn't that good. The hostel and campus are ragging-free, so there's no stress about it, as the hostel management is strict about it. There is a lot of free space to roam around in the campus and the hostels.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: A decent college with good opportunities. If you put in effort.

review_content.Placements: The placement scenario for this CSE department is that around 62-75 percent of the students from our batch got through campus placements. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA to 15 LPA, mainly for the product-based international rows. The lowest package is about 3 LPA. While the average package ranges between 4 LPA and 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Infosys, HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Veltech has good infrastructure for the CSE department. Classrooms are fully equipped, and labs are well-maintained with decent systems and internet connectivity. The library is large and has a good collection of technical books, journals, and digital resources, which are helpful for academics and projects. Hostel facilities are average to good, and rooms are clean and regularly maintained. The best food is manageable, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A good college with supportive faculty, decent placements, and campus life.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are average to good, depending on the student's skills and academic performance. Around 60–70% of students from my batch get placed through campus placements. The placement cell is active and provides training in aptitude, technical skills, resume preparation, and mock interviews. The highest package offered is around 6–8 LPA, the lowest package is about 2–3 LPA, and the average package is nearly 3.5–4 LPA. Most students receive packages in the average range.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is good and well-maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated. They are equipped with projectors and boards. Laboratories are well equipped with the required systems and instruments for practical learning. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Though the speed may vary at times. Library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, journals, and digital resources. It helps with academics and exam preparation. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean rooms. Along with regular water supply, and basic facilities. The quality of food in the mess is average, hygienic. Menu is changed regularly.

review_summary.college_name: Vel Tech Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college faculty.

content.Placements: In my course, which was B.Teach in Computer Science and Design, 75 percent of students were placed. In my course, the highest package was 9 LPA, the lowest package was 3 LPA, and the average package is 5 to 6 LPA. Amazon, Accenture, Infosys, etc., recruited. 55 Percent of students got internships in Accenture, Infosys, Genpact, etc. Top roles offered in my course was web Designer, Graphic Designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure that were available in our department were extremely good. It consisted of digital labs, wi-fi, digital classrooms, and a library for different departments. The quality of facilities in the hostel was excellent. It consisted of AC and non-AC rooms, and there were 6 hostels, four hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls, and these hostels had 24/7 monitoring systems for security. The food quality was excellent, they kept non-veg 6 days a week, along with veg and for every block there was a medical facility which was 24/7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college provides good placements, training, infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The college was excellent, and coming to the placements, the college has excellent placements and training. Seventy per cent of students have been placed this year. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Accenture, Infosys, Cognizant. Roles offered are software engineer, data engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are very good. They provide projectors in teaching classes and provide Wi-Fi and smart classrooms, as well as extraordinary lab facilities. The library has a smart library, and extra facilities are available all over the college. The hostel is good, and the food is good. They provide Wi-Fi and a good atmosphere in the rooms, along with medical facilities. Sports and games are very good, and they conduct games for all hostellers to make them happy.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely trash faculty here.

content.Placements: Our college is a great place to get your research skills upto the mark as it supports research-based studies more, and it encourages research more than the studies going on statistically in the classes. If you want to join my college, then come here if you have an interest in doing research.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel Wi-Fi is provided, and necessities like water and electricity are provided 24/7, but the food isn't that good. The hostel and campus are ragging-free, so there's no stress about it, as the hostel management is strict about it. There is a lot of free space to roam around in the campus and the hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A decent college with good opportunities. If you put in effort.

content.Placements: The placement scenario for this CSE department is that around 62-75 percent of the students from our batch got through campus placements. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA to 15 LPA, mainly for the product-based international rows. The lowest package is about 3 LPA. While the average package ranges between 4 LPA and 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Infosys, HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Veltech has good infrastructure for the CSE department. Classrooms are fully equipped, and labs are well-maintained with decent systems and internet connectivity. The library is large and has a good collection of technical books, journals, and digital resources, which are helpful for academics and projects. Hostel facilities are average to good, and rooms are clean and regularly maintained. The best food is manageable, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A good college with supportive faculty, decent placements, and campus life.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are average to good, depending on the student's skills and academic performance. Around 60–70% of students from my batch get placed through campus placements. The placement cell is active and provides training in aptitude, technical skills, resume preparation, and mock interviews. The highest package offered is around 6–8 LPA, the lowest package is about 2–3 LPA, and the average package is nearly 3.5–4 LPA. Most students receive packages in the average range.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is good and well-maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated. They are equipped with projectors and boards. Laboratories are well equipped with the required systems and instruments for practical learning. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Though the speed may vary at times. Library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, journals, and digital resources. It helps with academics and exam preparation. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean rooms. Along with regular water supply, and basic facilities. The quality of food in the mess is average, hygienic. Menu is changed regularly.

admission_overview.college_name: Vel Tech Course Admissions 2025: Fees, Eligibility, Dates & Selection Process

paragraphs: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology or Vel Tech Universityadmissions 2025 are openfor various courses. The university offers courses at UG, PG and PhD levels across the streams of Engineering, Technology, Science, Management, Law and Commerce. Vel Tech admissions are bothmerit and entrance-based.Vel Techaccepts either its in-house entrance exam, i.e.,VTUEEEand national-level entrance exams such asCLAT and LSAT. For Vel Tech admission, the applications are accepted in online mode only.

Candidates are admitted toVel Tech UG & PG coursesbased on merit and entrance exam scores. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements before applying for the courses at the university. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to Vel Tech University course admission 2025:
Class 12 with 60% aggregate
Class 12 with respective subjects
Class 12 with minimum 50% aggregate
Graduation with 50% aggregate

Vel Tech admission process consists of multiple steps, including fulfilling the basic eligibility criteria, qualifying for the selection criteria and filling an application form. Check below the detailed process for Vel Tech admission 2025:
Step 1: Application Process

Vel Tech application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates can fill an online application form on the university's official website for their desired programme. During the application process, candidates must also upload the relevant supporting documents of their past academics. Along with that, they must also pay an application fee before submitting the form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Vel Tech University admissions are both merit entrance-based for selective courses. For admission to courses such as BTech, BCom LLB and BA LLB, candidates are admitted based on scores of entrance exams such as VTUEEE, CLAT, LSAT, etc., respectively. However, admission to courses such as MTech, BBA, MSc, etc., is entirely merit-based.
Step 3: Final Admission
Once all the selection rounds are completed, the qualified candidates are offered seats in their respective courses. The selected candidates must pay a certain amount of fee to confirm their seats.

nirf.description:
Vel Tech has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Vel Tech's rank is #151, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Vel Tech fell 5 ranks to #101 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Vel Tech fell 1 rank to #87 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
It is noticeable that in the 'Innovation' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, Vel Tech's rank is #11, the same as last year's rank in the 'Innovation' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Rayat Bahra University: An overview of academic structure and student development.
reviews.review_text: Separate hostels for boys and girls are available on campus, designed to give a safe and comfortable home-away-from-home for students. Rayat Bahra University's every hostel includes common rooms, activity areas, dining/mess hall, reading rooms, and canteen access. Rayat Bahra University facilities typically include hot water in winter, Wi-Fi internet, security, and power supply.

reviews.review_heading: The amount of fees they charge does not justify the services they provide. Not recommended.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are clean and well-made. There are good labs with proper equipment, proper boards and screens for study purposes, but there are no Wi-Fi or AC facilities. The library is good and spacious, but it does not have books from all courses, so you have to submit an application to request books, and you will do so. The hostel facilities are not good. Most of the rooms have fungus growing on the walls, there is no proper ventilation, the bathrooms are not properly cleaned, and the food is ...

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in this university, as various developments are going on
reviews.review_text: Department of Computer Science and Engineering of Rayat Bahra University is well-equipped to meet the academic and technical needs of students. The campus offers high-speed Wi-Fi internet, where labs are equipped with updated software and high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with an enhanced learning system.

reviews.review_heading: According to me, it is an average college, not that much bad or good but just a mix of it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. The whole university is smaller than you expect but they are renovating the building regularly and about the classrooms and library, they both are good the only issue with them is, even though they've given free Wi-Fi, it doesn't work all the time and the speed is slow. The hostel I've heard is not the best but not the worst too, the food in the mess is average. Canteens and shops have great value. The sports facility is only available after the class hours that is...

reviews.review_heading: It is an amazing university. The college provides good placements for doctors and engineers.
reviews.review_text: We have a separate laboratory for each subject. We have an anatomy subject and for that, we have a good lab with good equipment. The hostel quality is extraordinary. The food is almost good but as you can understand hostel food is hostel food it can't taste like home food but it is good, healthy, and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Please don't take admission here your future will be spoiled.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good as free Wi-Fi for everyone. Labs are also good and all the devices in the lab working properly. Library is so awesome as all the content you can get from the library. I'm a day scholar so I can't say anything about mess and hostel. Very poor in sports and spoiling all the athlete's lives.

reviews.review_heading: Almost 80% students are placed.
reviews.review_text: 100% satisfied, well-equipped classrooms, a well-stocked library, and functional computer and science labs. The university also provides Wi-Fi access. The university also provides well-equipped to support practical learning and research. The campus is best.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Clinical Embryology at Rayat Bahra University.
reviews.review_text: There are a lot of facilities available here. Wi-Fi facility are also provided across the whole campus. Hostels are good too, and they also have Wi-Fi. Gym facilities are provided too. The mess food is good too. Classrooms are attached to labs, so you can have full hands-on experience.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rayat Bahra University.
reviews.review_text: There is a central library from where you can issue books for some time and you can sit there and study till 4:00 PM, if you are a day scholar and for hostel student it is open 24/7 and provided with Wi-Fi in library. Classrooms have infrastructure and sufficient space where approximately 35-40 students can sit properly. Now if we talk about hostel, good rooms are available in hostel but mess food is not worth it according to the payment we have made for mess.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with staff and resources provided at this university.
reviews.review_text: We have well-equipped classrooms, a well maintained library, computer labs, science labs, as well as Wi-Fi facility in this college. There is 20X7 access to library for the hostlers. The quality of food is also very good. There are 24*7 medical facilities available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review of college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure that has buildings classroom are well maintained and are comfortable for the better environment of students. Moreover, there is no air-conditioner so in summer it is difficult to study in classrooms due to excessive heat. Rather than this, everything is very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Great BCA course and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our BCA department has modern computer labs, WiFi, spacious classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel facilities are clean, and the mess offers hygienic food. Medical support is available on campus, and there are good sports facilities for indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: University is good but the hostel is not recommended.
reviews.review_text: The campus is tidy and green with lots of trees and parks. The classes have windows and are well ventilated with enough space to accommodate a good amount of students in one class. However, hostel facilities are lacking. They take 55,000 from us per semester, and the room is not even provided with basic facilities. The food in the hostel mess is another disaster. Not recommending hostels.

reviews.review_heading: I am a student, Rayat Bahra University heading towards my future and making it bright.
reviews.review_text: There are a large number of classrooms with great infrastructure. Each classroom is equipped with a projector for displaying the content of topics related to the syllabus, which helps students in smart, easy, and efficient learning.

reviews.review_heading: Very Much Satisfied with the Campus
reviews.review_text: The complete campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and the hostel also has Wi-Fi facilities. For day scholars, the library is open until 4:30 PM (Mon-Fri), but hostelers get access to the library 24/7. It has all labs for medical and non-medical courses, as well as for HM courses and other courses too. The food quality is average, and there is a hospital from the Bhara group nearby. Various games and grounds are also available on campus.

reviews_list.review_title: Good faculty, decent placements but has a potential to do better.

review_content.Placements: In the final placements for the 2018-2020 batch 124 students had participated in the placement process. The highest package offered was 22.47 lacs, the lowest was 8.5 lacs. Top recruiters included firms from the manufacturing sector and IT sector. Mean CTC was 12.87 lacs and median CTC was 12.09 lacs. review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is amazing. The classrooms are well-equipped with the latest technical tools. Wi-Fi is accessible anywhere within the campus. Library is equipped with all the books, journals, magazines, newspapers ( Mint, Hindu, Business Standard, TOI, Economic times) and we also have 4 bloomberg terminals. The mess has options for meal and ala care and there is night mess available tim 2 AM. The food like any other hostel is average. Medical service is available, doctor is present there every evening and there is a sick room available as well. Recently, the international center was inaugurated. The top recruiting companies of our course are Reliance, Deloitte, Arcesium, Tata Steel, etc. All the first-year students also got placed with an average salary of Rs. 72,000 per month. Above mentioned companies only visit here for SIP.

content.Placements: 1. 100% students got placements. 2. The highest salary -27.5 LPA, Average -13 LPA was offered to the students. 3. 100% people bagged internship. content.Placements: In our last to last batch, we had 100 % placement and the salary ranges were between 8-15 Lacs give or take depending on the experience you are carrying. Top recruiting companies varies year to year depending on their requirements but the big 4's in HR remains constant. Since modern world is getting more agile and data driven, top companies are also preferring that roles and looking for smart individuals. All of our students got internship in different companies ranging from big 4's to the banks and even the startups also offered a handsome package to the students for their internship.

hostel_campus.college_name: Tula's Institute Dehradun Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: In-Campus 4 boys hostels and 2 girls hostels with rooms on twin sharing basis and the rooms are spacious, ventilated, airy and well lit. Each hosteler is provided 24-hour WIFI facility, separate table and chair and separate bookshelves. An educational Committee organizes regular movies shows at the auditorium, inter-hostel sports matches, recreational trips for the hostel students. Mess serves breakfast, lunch, evening tea and dinner every day.
facilities: Library: The institute provides well well-developed library with access to all the latest books, Journals, magazines and audio/video resources.
On-Campus Internship: The institute provides OCI facility to enable the students to work on live projects.
Hostel: The institute provides separate hostels for boys and girls. All the hostels are equipped with modern amenities to provide a comfortable and safe environment to the students.
Canteen: There is a modernised canteen on the campus which provides hygienic and organic food to students.
Security: To provide a secure space to students, the campus provides 24*7 power backup, wifi connectivity, and ambulance service.
Events: The campus conducts various events from time to time. Some of the events, such as DAZZLE and Apratim Pragya Pratispardha, provide a delightful engagement among students.

Sports: Tula's Institute Dehradun provides an excellent infrastructure for indoor and outdoor sports. The institute provides space for Pickleball, cricket, football, volleyball, basketball, table tennis and gymnasium. Intensive training is provided by coaches for national and international tournaments.

Zero-tolerance policy: The institute has a zero-tolerance policy for activities such as ragging, smoking and drinking on the campus. One of the aims of the institute is to provide a culture of respect, discipline, and academic excellence

admission_process.title: LEAD College of Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: LEAD College of Management admission 2025is both merit and entrance-based. The college offers two courses; MBA and MCA at the postgraduate level. Students can pursue the course across several specialisations, such as Marketing, HR, Finance, and more. The admission and application process mainly commences online. Aspiring students can read the following article to know all about the courses, scholarships, eligibility, and admission process of Leadership & Entrepreneurship Academy, Dhoni (LEAD) College of Management.

LEAD College of Management course admissionis done on the basis of fulfilment of the preset admission criteria. Students seeking to get into the courses offered at LEAD Palakkad, Kerala are required to have passed graduation from a recognised university. Further, students need to provide entrance exam scores for the MBA course. While for the MCA course, it is optional to appear for the state-level entrance exam (LBS-MCA Entrance Examination). Additionally, the college also reserves 50% of the total seats under management quota. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria forLEAD College of Management courses:
Eligibility
Graduation with 50% (45% for reserved categories) from a recognised university
CAT|CMAT|KMAT
Graduation in the relevant field with a minimum aggregate of 50% (45% for reserved categories) from a recognised university
Merit-based

The admission procedure for LEAD College of Management involves several steps, such as application, selection, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission into the offered courses are required to fulfil the eligibility and selection criteria before applying. Eligible candidates can follow the step-wise LEAD College of Management admission process explained below:
Step 1: LEAD College of Management Application Process

Students can visit the official website of the college and apply for the desired course by filling out the online application form. Students need to pay the application fees to complete the process. For the MCA course, students need to fill out the Google form available on the college's website.
Step 2:LEAD College of Management Selection Process

Students must clear the qualifying entrance examination (any ofKMAT/ CMAT/ CAT) LEAD College of Management admissions. Further, students need to appear for an institute-level personal interview round Candidates who have successfully cleared the personal interview will be granted admission to LEAD College of Management. Candidates will be selected based on academic performance, and scores obtained in the entrance exam followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD&PI).
Step 3: LEAD College of Management Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to pay the admissionfeesto confirm their seat at the college.

reviews_list.review_title: There is nothing to say about the college.

review_content.Placements: There is no one is placed in any company because the college is not interested in starting campus interviews. Many students go for internships with local companies, and students are also attending YouTube classes. There are no new projectors attached in the department.
review_content.Infrastructure: Boys' restroom is below average, and the canteen is under construction, so there is no canteen in the college. The bike parking area is small, and boys' and girls' parking areas are 500 meters apart. We have already complained to the principal, but no action has been taken.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: The faculty, staff, and students make it feel like a home.

review_content.Placements: The students in the 2nd year are eligible to get placements from this college. Our college's highest package is around 20 lakh per annum, and the average package is around 3 to 4 lakh per annum. Companies visiting our college include TCS, HCL, Amazon, Flipkart, and more than 30 other companies. One of the best things about my college is that if there are no placements from outside companies, there is a private company associated with our college that provides placements for students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college actually works on the motto "freedom with responsibility." It encourages the student community to develop by hosting numerous events almost every day, whether they are small or grand. The main events include concerts and DJ parties, such as Techlectics (a tech fest hosted every two years in February-March), Mech Fest (hosted every year around November), Qubit (November), Prisma (April), and numerous sports events like the Civilian Cup, Electrical Cup, Sports Day, etc. The arts fest is also hosted every year.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, DMIHER outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 13 ranks to #84 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, DMIHER fell 7 ranks to #49 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'Medical' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER climbed 3 ranks to #20 rank in the 'Medical' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
The institute's ranks in the 'Dental' category; have descended when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 12 ranks to #36 rank in the 'Dental' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

review_content.Placements: According to what I know, there were 78 students placed from a batch of 100 students, and the others mostly went to higher studies. The highest package was 23 LPA. The average package was around 6 LPA. The placement cell is helpful and trained.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: A place fit for cultivating yourself without any external disturbance (unnecessary drama, etc).

review_content.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in computer engineering and am currently in 2nd year. Although my batch is yet to graduate, I have observed that the percentage of students getting placed is rather good (around 70-80%). The highest package was 51 LPA, and the average one was around 4.8 LPA in the year 2023. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Infosys, Wipro, etc. Around 60-65% of students secured internships in companies like Wipro, TCS, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, QA engineer, system analyst, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for CS are satisfactory. Things like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc., are all well-maintained and looked after. Apart from the department-specific library, there is also a general library available. Plenty of high-end PC's are available for various applications. Classrooms have good sunlight entry as well. Hostel facilities are satisfactory as well. All the necessary things are provided by the hostel. The food provided in the mess and canteen is also of good quality. There is also the availability of sports and games which will help the students.
